name: Erogeteki ni Imouto Suki!
source:
Brother continues playing eroge while staying numb towards feelings of his real sister. One day his friend confesses his feelings to the sister. What should brother do in this situation?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
哥哥继续玩着成人游戏，对亲妹妹的感情始终麻木不仁。一天，他的朋友向妹妹告白了。哥哥在这种情况下该怎么办？
